series_label: Proportion of population using at least basic drinking water services (Nigeria, total residence, all wealth quintiles)
source_or_custodian: WHO/UNICEF Joint Monitoring Programme (JMP), as served via the UNICEF SDMX data warehouse (dataflow UNICEF/WASH_HOUSEHOLDS/1.0)
status_or_notes: No value returned for 2025; the server's series ends at 2024 (25 annual observations for 2000-2024). Values are for RESIDENCE=_T (total); the server also holds urban and rural series (the urban series started 68.7 in 2000). Wealth quintile = _T (total), service type WAT. OBS_STATUS and OBS_FOOTNOTE were empty.
definition: Percentage of the population using an improved drinking water source, where collection time is not more than 30 minutes for a round trip including queuing (improved sources include: piped water; boreholes or tubewells; protected dug wells; protected springs; rainwater; and packaged or delivered water)
